source_text.Q-1042: CI lever: per-test tenant-template clone cost. Acceptance: (1) instrumented measurement quoted; (2) one lever implemented with before/after wall time of the test phase (5 runs each, run ids); (3) isolation proof: a test that leaves data behind must not leak (mutation test); (4) no change to required CI check names; no paid runners.

task.description: WF-03 pre-close RELEASE-VALIDATOR gate for ISS-1042 (.claude/agents/release-validator.md). Independently re-derive each of the 4 acceptance criteria from files and your OWN runs; do not trust the TEST-RUNNER report. You write no code. Checks: (1) docs/issues/ISS-1042.yaml quotes the instrumented measurement; spot-check it against step-01 handoff and, if feasible, nothing more. (2) before/after: re-verify the 5+5 table is in the report with per-run ids; AND independently run ONE 'after' sample and ONE 'before' sample (MIX_TEST_PARTITION=1 mix test --partitions 12 --seed 0; before = throwaway worktree at cc65f7b16, after = branch head in another throwaway worktree; throwaway postgres port 5499, remove afterwards) and confirm the direction and rough magnitude (>=20% faster) of the claimed speedup; note the claimed 542 vs 527 test-count difference between arms and judge whether it undermines the comparison (e.g. compare time per test or the per-module times of the three adopter files, which are identical code in both arms). (3) isolation: confirm the pool test + mutant table; run test/letflow/support/tenant_fixture_pool_test.exs once yourself. (4) `git diff cc65f7b16..HEAD --stat` : confirm no change under .github/, no workflow/job name changes, no paid-runner labels, no lib/ or priv/ changes. Also check the diff for scope creep and that docs/anti-patterns.md entry exists. Record R4 (docs say 57 tables of a clone; a clone has 50 plain tables) as a known pending doc fix, not a blocker. Verdict PASS/FAIL in result.status, handoff status COMPLETED; list any findings with file:line. MACHINE RULE: only ONE BEAM at a time machine-wide; every mix invocation takes the mutex, one acquisition per invocation, wrapper: L=/c/Users/tvolo/AppData/Local/Temp/claude/mixlock; mkdir -p "$(dirname "$L")"; until mkdir "$L" 2>/dev/null; do sleep 20; done; trap 'rmdir "$L" 2>/dev/null' EXIT; cd <dir> && <ONE mix invocation> 2>&1 . Foreground/polling only, no Monitors. Clean up worktrees/container. Commit the handoff and push (message ends with 'Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>').

own before/after sample and pool test run output quoted

result.summary: All 4 acceptance criteria independently re-verified. Own before/after sample: before (cc65f7b16) Finished in 399.5s, 542 passed; after (branch head) 286.1s, 527 passed -> -28.4% wall (0.737 vs 0.543 s/test, -26%), >=20% threshold met. Pool test: 57 passed (1 property, 56 tests), 82.3s.

criteria.1_instrumented_measurement: PASS: docs/issues/ISS-1042.yaml measurements quote clone mean 839ms/median 711ms/max 3107ms, 50 tables/clone, fixture share 74.0% (run A) / 80.4% (run B); 74.0/80.4/452.6s spot-checked against step-01 handoff.
criteria.2_before_after: PASS: report + ISS yaml hold 5+5 table with ids B1..B5/A1..A5 (before mean 367.9, after 256.2, -30.4%, every after run faster than every before run). Own samples: before 399.5s (542 passed), after 286.1s (527 passed), same direction and magnitude; after-arm pool_acquire log lines 125 clean / 78 reset / 1 rebuilt, matching the report. 542 vs 527 count difference does not undermine: per-test time drops 26% as well, sync time dominates, and direction replicated 11/11 (10 reported + mine). Caveat stays documented (partition membership shifted by file hashing).
criteria.3_isolation: PASS: tenant_fixture_pool_test.exs 57 passed on my run; TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR 9 independent mutants (6 killed, 3 survivors analysed: 1 equivalent, 1 outside design claim, 1 perf-only), designer 35-mutant table not re-run by me.
